visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length black hair is sitting on a white swing with a yellow cushion. She is wearing an off-white, long-sleeved collared shirt. Her hands rest on her lap, and she stares blankly ahead with a hollow, dazed facial expression. The background is a vibrant green, sunlit lawn. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor, dimly lit room. The same woman sits on a blue upholstered chair. A white, translucent, ghost-like vapor or silhouette rises from her body towards the ceiling, mimicking a 'soul leaving the body' effect. The background shows a dark room with some blurry furniture and a computer monitor. (3) The scene shifts back outdoors to a concrete sloped path near some greenery. The woman stands with her hands behind her back, looking off-camera with the same vacant, shocked expression. A blue wall and some tropical plants are visible in the background, along with the legs of another person standing behind her.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous visual metaphor (a soul leaving the body) to express the intense mental exhaustion and dread a person feels when realizing they must return to work the next day. The blank expressions and dramatic music emphasize the relatable 'Monday Blues' feeling.
